It is part of the "Battle Pass: Age of War - Chapter 4" DLC, so players without that content cannot obtain it. Tier 1 places it in the lower band of the game's weapon progression.

Its base damage of 41 ranks #35 of 109 Two Handed Spear entries tracked here. It has a modest 8.1% armor penetration, a 9-stamina cost per basic swing, 10 poise damage that helps interrupt enemies, and 1400 durability before it needs repair. At 4.16 weight it is light to carry.
Heavy swings drain stamina fast but pay off with crowd control and armor-breaking openers.
zingaran-mercenary-spear-epic.verdict: Overall Zingaran Mercenary Spear is a strong pick among Two Handed Spear weapons in Conan Exiles, and being craftable makes it easy to replace if it breaks.
